2609.38543.title: MedKIT: Evaluating Knowledge Integration and Generalization in Large Language Models
2609.38543.paper_summary: Constantly evolving real-world knowledge necessitates models to be updated continuously. Especially in medicine, as clinical evidence changes over time, outdated knowledge can pose safety risks. Existing evaluations of knowledge integration focus on factual recall, offering limited insight into whether newly integrated knowledge is actually usable. Our benchmark MedKIT (Medical Knowledge Integration and Transfer) provides a granular evaluation of how models integrate and apply knowledge under realistic sequences of clinical updates. Each instance corresponds to a factual update derived from clinical evidence, paired with targeted probes that assess transfer across lexical variation, relational transformations, compositional reasoning, and open-ended operationalization, as well as locality tests for knowledge preservation. Using MedKIT, we conduct a large-scale empirical study of 12 knowledge integration strategies across 5 diverse models, including both general-purpose and medical LLMs. Our results reveal a consistent gap between recall and usable knowledge: while most methods achieve strong gains on the original update task and under lexical variation, relational generalization is limited, and no method yields meaningful improvements on compositional or operational tasks. These findings highlight a fundamental challenge in knowledge integration and position MedKIT as a testbed for developing methods that make newly integrated knowledge more consistently usable across tasks and contexts.
2609.38543.paper_summary_zh: 不斷演變的現實世界知識需要模型持續更新。尤其在醫學領域，隨著臨床證據隨時間改變，過時的知識可能會帶來安全風險。現有的知識整合評估專注於事實回憶，對於新整合知識是否實際可用提供的見解有限。我們的基準 MedKIT（醫療知識整合與轉移）提供了對模型如何在現實臨床更新序列中整合和應用知識的細緻評估。每個實例對應於源自臨床證據的事實更新，並配有針對性的探測，評估在詞彙變化、關係轉換、組合推理和開放式操作化方面的轉移，以及知識保留的局部性測試。使用 MedKIT，我們對 5 種不同模型中的 12 種知識整合策略進行了大規模實證研究，包括通用和醫療 LLM。我們的結果顯示回憶與可用知識之間存在一致的差距：雖然大多數方法在原始更新任務和詞彙變化下取得了顯著增益，但關係概括有限，且沒有方法在組合或操作任務上產生有意義的改進。這些發現突顯了知識整合中的一個基本挑戰，並將 MedKIT 定位為開發方法的測試平台，使新整合的知識在各任務和上下文中更一致地可用。
